subject: AWS Marketplace listing — partner onboarding + product copy sync
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acmecloud.com>, Alex Mendez <alex.mendez@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing — partner onboarding + product copy sync

Hi Jamie / Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great fit. We kicked off the AWS Marketplace listing prep on our side and wanted to align on a few things so we can finish the product page copy, confirm co-sell readiness, and hand off assets to the AWS upload team.

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm the AWS Seller ID and the preferred legal entity for the Marketplace listing (we need exact capitalization)?
- Attachments we need from you: high-res product logo (SVG), hero image (1600x900), and a one-line product summary for the top of the page.
- Pricing model: do you want a SaaS subscription, BYOL, or metered usage? If subscription, please confirm SKU names and list prices for the first three tiers.
- Co-sell: are you already registered in the AWS ISV Accelerate / Co-sell program? If not, do you want us to start the co-sell enablement intake?
- Any marketing claims we should avoid or legal constraints (data residency, HIPAA, PCI, etc.) that must appear in the copy?

We attached a draft product page (final_listing_copy_v1.docx) and a pricing worksheet (pricing-table-v2.xlsx) with proposed copy and placeholder SKUs. Please review and comment inline. Our proposed hero one-liner is: "Low-latency inference for LLMs — predictable cost, enterprise controls." If you'd prefer a different emphasis (cost / compliance / performance), tell us which direction.

Goal: finalize assets this week so we can get the listing uploaded to AWS next week and submit co-sell paperwork by 7/26.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the upload with the AWS marketplace team once we have the seller id and final assets.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Marketplace Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: final_listing_copy_v1.docx (docx, 42KB), pricing-table-v2.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mendez <alex.mendez@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — partner onboarding + product copy sync

Thanks Aditya — excited to move forward. Quick answers inline: 

- AWS Seller ID: ACME-12345 (please use that exact string).
- Legal entity: Acme Cloud, Inc. (do not abbreviate).
- Attachments attached: acme_logo.svg, hero_image_v3.png, acme_sellerid.txt (contains seller id and Seller Central contact).
- Pricing: we prefer a subscription with a metered add-on. Proposed tiers in the attached pricing-table-v2.xlsx (you’ll see three SKUs: acme-lite, acme-pro, acme-enterprise). The pro and enterprise SKUs include optional token-metered usage at $0.0008/token above included quota.
- Co-sell: we are in the AWS ISV Accelerate pipeline but not yet fully validated. We want Redwood to submit the co-sell intake — please do that and loop us for any partner forms.
- Compliance: we are SOC 2 Type II compliant; we cannot claim HIPAA unless a Business Associate Agreement is in place. Data residency: EU and US options; please include a short note in the product page about region-specific hosting.

I also left three inline comments in final_listing_copy_v1.docx suggesting the hero be more customer-centered (e.g., "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost") and to tighten the third bullet under "Why Redwood+Acme".

We can get you an updated logo and a 16:9 hero asset in the next 24 hours. If you need the MSA signed, let me know and I’ll route to legal.

Cheers,
Jamie
Head of Partnerships
Acme Cloud, Inc.
attachments: acme_logo.svg (svg, 24KB), hero_image_v3.png (png, 320KB), acme_sellerid.txt (txt, 1KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AWS Marketplace listing — partner onboarding + product copy sync

Aditya / Jonas — forwarding Jamie's reply with a few suggested edits before we send the next draft to Acme. I pasted the key items below and added inline notes.

On Mon, Jul 19, 2027 at 1:05 PM Jamie Park <jamie.park@acmecloud.com> wrote:
> (quoted) Pricing: we prefer a subscription with a metered add-on...

Suggested copy edits (quick):
- Hero one-liner: change to: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and transparent unit economics." (shorter, benefits-first)
- Top bullets (Why Redwood + Acme): reorder: 1) predictable latency SLA, 2) configurable cost controls (batching/quantization), 3) enterprise security and private deployment options.
- Footnote for pricing: add a single-line footnote: "Metered usage billed monthly based on actual tokens consumed; overages prorated to nearest hour." Kimberly to run legal check on that phrasing.
- SKU naming: suggest upper-case prefix RDW-ACME- to match other listings (we'll sync with Acme if they want a different convention).

Ops/Upload notes:
- We need the Seller Central contact (Jamie provided) plus a contact with upload access on their side. If their upload person is different, we'll need to coordinate scheduling with AWS because uploads require verification windows.
- If Acme wants co-sell submitted, we should gather their Partner ID and any existing ISV Accelerate intake numbers.

Jonas — can you verify the hero image sizes and advise if the provided hero_image_v3.png passes our quality checks? If not, tell me what to ask of the partner.

Thanks — I can do a legal quick-check on the price footnote once Jamie confirms the metered terms.

-Kimberly
Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — partner onboarding + product copy sync

Jamie — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Next steps from our side:

1) We will update the listing copy with Kimberly's edits (hero + reordered bullets) and rename SKUs to RDW-ACME-LITE / RDW-ACME-PRO / RDW-ACME-ENT for consistency. See attached final_listing_copy_v1.docx (tracked changes) and pricing-table-v2.xlsx (updated).
2) I will submit the co-sell intake to AWS ISV Accelerate and include Acme's Seller ID (ACME-12345) and your Partner contact. Expect an intro from the AWS partner team within 3–5 business days after submission.
3) Please confirm who will perform the Seller Central upload on Acme's side (name + email + AWS account admin access). If you'd like Redwood to upload, we'll need a short upload authorization from your admin.
4) Legal: Kimberly will run a quick check on the metered billing footnote; if any changes required we will iterate.

Target timeline: finalize copy & assets by 7/21 EOD, submission to AWS by 7/22, co-sell intake submitted by 7/23, listing live target 7/27.

DocuSign: I’m attaching a pre-fill MSA for signature if needed (DocuSign envelope: envelope-00a1b2c3). If you want us to handle the upload, please reply with the upload contact by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks again — will follow up after Kimberly's legal quick-check.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Marketplace Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: final_listing_copy_v1.docx (docx, 45KB, tracked changes), pricing-table-v2.xlsx (xlsx, 21KB, updated), acme_sellerid.txt (txt, 1KB), hero_image_v3.png (png, 320KB), acme_logo.svg (svg, 24KB)
